rules: rho: Spearman rank correlation, over the kept vocabulary, between a lens's logits for the unit's write and the mean change in log-probabilities when the write is added at the unit's layer (dose x write, every position)
random units: drawn from the same layer and kind, each pushed with the same write norm as a tested unit
chance: another unit's read (same layer) against this unit's steering (the mismatched pair)
per layer and overall: median rho of tested units minus that of random units, 95% bootstrap interval (tested and random units resampled separately); overall weights each layer by its tested units
verdict: more (or less) lens-predictable than random units when the overall interval excludes 0
flag 'lens misses': rho below the 5% quantile of its layer's random units (10+ random units) and at least 0.1 below their median
flag 'label disagrees': the label names none of the top tokens of any lens read nor of the steering
